data.name: Launch_Hint
data.value: Runs once at login, top to bottom · drag rows to reorder. On a schedule or an event → Scheduled tasks; on demand with one tap → Action Groups.

data.name: Reminder_Hint
data.value: Fires at a time, at login, or on events like unlock / power — a reminder, or a group run silently. Just opening apps at login → Startup List; on demand with one tap → Action Groups.

data.name: Group_Hint
data.value: Bundle a routine and fire it any time via hotkey / tray; the Startup List and Scheduled tasks can reference it too. Something that only runs at login is simpler as plain Startup List steps.

data.name: System_Footer
data.value: Checking / unchecking takes effect immediately (disable, not delete; reversible).

data.name: System_ShowReadOnlyTip
data.value: System / policy / one-time read-only items are hidden by default.

data.name: Ports_ShowAllTip
data.value: When one process holds several ports, only the outward-facing one is listed. Check this to list every port and skip the filter above.

data.name: Ports_DevOnlyTip
data.value: Lists only services started from one of your project folders, recognized by markers like .git or package.json. Uncheck to see the rest of your listening software.

data.name: Ports_Footer
data.value: Double-click a row to open it in your browser; right-click to free the port.

data.name: Gesture_RehookHint
data.value: Another program (a mouse driver, AutoHotkey, another gesture tool) may sit ahead of us and swallow the right button — everything here looks fine and yet no right button arrives. The most recently installed hook comes first, so reinstalling takes the front of the queue back.

data.name: Gesture_WatchDeaf
data.value: Hooked, but no input arrives — try running as administrator

data.name: Gesture_WatchBlocked
data.value: Another program is taking the right button (AutoHotkey, a mouse driver…)

data.name: Gesture_Hint
data.value: Hold the right button, draw a stroke, and the matching action runs. With no gestures set, the right button behaves as usual.

data.name: Gesture_None
data.value: No gestures yet. Click Add, pick an action, then draw a stroke on the right.

data.name: Val_GestureDup
data.value: Gesture {0} is already used by “{1}”; draw a different stroke

data.name: Settings_LangRestart
data.value: Clockwork restarts right away to apply a new language.

data.name: Warn_WaitClipboard
data.value: The clipboard did not change within {0}s; continuing anyway

data.name: Warn_AskNoUi
data.value: This step needs to ask you something, and there is nobody to ask on this path (this run is unattended). Skipped.

data.name: Warn_DestructiveNoUi
data.value: This step deletes something irreversibly and needs your confirmation first, and there is nobody to ask on this path (this run is unattended). Skipped.

data.name: Warn_ChoiceNoOptions
data.value: This step has no options configured, so there is nothing to choose from. Skipped.

data.name: Ed_UrlHint
data.value: Supports {clipboard}: replaced at run time with the text on the clipboard, URL-escaped. Pair it with "Get Selected Text" to search whatever you selected.

data.name: Ed_CopySelectionHint
data.value: Presses the copy key for you and puts the selected text on the clipboard. Later steps read it back with {clipboard}.

data.name: Ed_OptionsHint
data.value: One per line. At run time these are listed and you pick one.

data.name: Ed_OutputVarHint
data.value: Later steps use {0} to refer to it. Leave it empty and this step produces nothing.

data.name: Mig_PageMoved
data.value: Panel page "{0}" moved out of your actions into Panel pages ({1} tile(s))

data.name: Mig_PageAndAction
data.value: "{0}" is both a panel page and an action (hotkey/referenced): the action is kept, and the page now holds one tile pointing at it

data.name: Mig_PageTrayDropped
data.value: Panel page "{0}" no longer appears in the tray menu (a page is not a runnable action)

data.name: Sys_monitorOff
data.value: Turn Off Monitor (move mouse to wake)

data.name: Ed_TopmostHint
data.value: This applies to each window separately: to turn it off again for a window, bring that window to the front first.

data.name: Ed_AppHint
data.value: Target can be a program (full path or bare name), shortcut, script, folder, URL, document, or a protocol like ms-settings:.

data.name: Ed_KeysHint
data.value: e.g. Win+D / Alt+K / Ctrl+Enter / F5. Sent to the focused window — make sure the target is in front first. Combos Windows itself owns (Win+D, Win+6…) can't be captured — double-click this box to type one. Mouse actions with modifiers live here too: scroll inside the box to record one (hold Ctrl to zoom, Shift for horizontal), and type LeftClick / DoubleClick / RightClick / MiddleClick / MouseBack / MouseForward for buttons. For plain scrolling or clicking, the Mouse step is easier.

data.name: Ed_MouseHint
data.value: Scrolling goes to the window under the pointer; clicks land wherever the pointer already is (this app never moves it), so put the target in place first with Window action → bring to front, or stick to position-independent actions like Back/Forward. Raise the repeat count below for N clicks or notches, and use the post-step delay for the rhythm.

data.name: Ed_WindowHint
data.value: Process name without .exe (e.g. Weixin / msedge). Bring-to-front / send-keys need foreground focus and may not work at startup.

data.name: Ed_RestoreHint
data.value: Brings back the window you were using when this action was triggered. Nothing to pick for this one.

data.name: Ed_TextHint
data.value: Types text literally (newline = Enter). Leave target process blank to send to the focused window (most reliable).

data.name: Ed_Confirm
data.value: Yes/No confirm (Yes = continue, No = abort the action)

data.name: Ed_DaysHeader
data.value: Run only on these weekdays (none = every day)

data.name: Ed_BeforeTimeHint
data.value: Format H:mm, e.g. 08:30; entering just the hour (e.g. 8) also works; default 08:00.

data.name: Warn_SendKeyFail
data.value: Failed to send keys to "{0}": window didn't appear, or couldn't bring it to front (common at startup/background triggers)

data.name: Warn_WindowNotFound
data.value: No window found for "{0}" (process not running or not ready?); {1} had no effect

data.name: Warn_WindowActionFailed
data.value: Found a window for "{0}" but {1} had no effect (foreground lock, the window refused to close, or it runs as administrator)

data.name: Warn_RestoreFailed
data.value: Could not get back to the previous window: the foreground is locked, or that window is gone.

data.name: Warn_NotForCurrentWindow
data.value: The current window does not allow this action ({0}): activating it is a no-op, and to send keys use the Send keys step instead. Skipped.

data.name: Warn_SelfSkip
data.value: Skipped "{0}": target is Clockwork itself (avoids an autostart loop)

data.name: Warn_QuickExit
data.value: "{0}" exited within 0.5s (exit code {1}); likely failed to start

data.name: Warn_ConfigUnreadable
data.value: Config file could not be read (likely malformed JSON); started with defaults. The original was backed up to {0} — fix it and restart to recover.

data.name: Err_ScriptMissing
data.value: Script file not found (enter a full path)

data.name: Err_ScriptNeedsPwsh
data.value: Script is UTF-8 without BOM, which Windows PowerShell 5.1 cannot decode correctly; install PowerShell 7, or re-save the script as UTF-8 with BOM

data.name: Ed_GroupHint
data.value: An action never runs on its own — trigger it from the tray menu, a global hotkey, a Run action step in the startup list, or a scheduled task.

data.name: Val_GroupName
data.value: Please give the action a name.

data.name: Ed_WithinHint
data.value: min of login counts as a login (0 = every launch)

data.name: Ed_AutoHint
data.value: auto-close if no click (0: card = never, dialog = 60s)

data.name: Toast_QuickSetDnd
data.value: Reminder set for {0} min, but reminders are paused — it will fire once the pause ends

data.name: Toast_QuickSet
data.value: Reminder set for {0} min from now ({1})

data.name: Ed_GraceHint
data.value: still fires if the time was missed within

data.name: Val_TimeFormat
data.value: Time must be in HH:mm format

data.name: Val_LoopUntil
data.value: "Interval run until" must be HH:mm (or blank)

data.name: Val_Anchor
data.value: Start date must be yyyy-MM-dd (or blank)

data.name: Val_OnceDatePast
data.value: That date has passed — this task will not fire (set a new date and re-enable to reuse)

data.name: Val_SilentNoGroup
data.value: "Run an action silently" is selected but no action is chosen

data.name: Confirm_Destructive
data.value: Are you sure you want to "{0}"?

data.name: Tray_LaunchWarn
data.value: Startup list done: {0} step(s), {1} with warnings (tray → view last startup log)

data.name: Hotkey_Unrecognized
data.value: Stop hotkey "{0}" not recognized; change it in the main window. Tray "Stop" still works.

data.name: Hotkey_RegisterFail
data.value: Failed to register stop hotkey "{0}" (may be in use by another app); tray "Stop" still works.

data.name: SysMsg_NeedsAdmin
data.value: "{0}" needs administrator rights to toggle; reopen Clockwork as administrator.

data.name: Update_Available
data.value: New version {0} available. Go to download?

data.name: Settings_HotkeyCaptureTip
data.value: Click, then press the shortcut. Esc cancels, Del clears it. "Stop" in the tray menu always works.

data.name: Confirm_DeletePage
data.value: Delete the page “{0}”? The {1} tile(s) on it go with it. A tile pointing at an action only removes that reference; the action itself stays.

data.name: Confirm_DeleteCategory
data.value: Delete the category “{0}”? The {1} page(s) in it are not deleted — they go back to “{2}”.

data.name: Confirm_DeleteSysItem
data.value: Permanently delete startup item "{0}" from the system? This cannot be undone (to just stop it from launching at startup, uncheck it instead).

data.name: Confirm_KillPort
data.value: Free port {0}? This ends {1}, along with any child processes. Anything unsaved is lost.

data.name: Confirm_KillPortAlso
data.value: That process also holds port {0}, which will be freed too.

data.name: Confirm_DeleteSysItemTakenOver
data.value: Startup item "{0}" has been taken over into the launch list, and a step still points to its shortcut file. Deleting it from the system also removes the shortcut, so that step will no longer be able to launch it. Delete anyway?

data.name: Config_ExportSamePath
data.value: The export target cannot be the config file itself — choose a different name or location.

data.name: Val_SendKeys
data.value: The send-keys text is not a valid key sequence: check for unclosed braces and unknown key names (e.g. {ENTER}; write a literal { as {{} and a literal } as {}}).

data.name: Val_SearchUrl
data.value: The search URL needs {0} — that is where the query goes. Without it, this step opens the same page every time.

data.name: Warn_KeyNoMain
data.value: Hotkey "{0}" has no main key; not sent

data.name: Warn_KeyMultiDigit
data.value: Unrecognized key name "{0}" (multi-digit numbers aren't keys); hotkey "{1}" not sent

data.name: Warn_KeyRejected
data.value: Hotkey "{0}" was rejected by the system (happens when an elevated window or the secure desktop is in front); no effect

data.name: Warn_KeyPartial
data.value: Hotkey "{0}" only partially injected ({1}/{2}); key-ups resent, no effect

data.name: Warn_TextSendFail
data.value: Send text: couldn't bring the "{0}" window to the front; not sent

data.name: Warn_SaveConfigFail
data.value: Failed to save config: {0} (changes are only in memory and will be lost on restart)

data.name: Warn_SilentGroupMissing

data.name: Toast_DndEndOfDay

data.name: Tpl_EndOfDayMsg

data.name: Tpl_SedentaryMsg
data.value: Get up and move around a bit

data.name: Smp_Mute

data.name: Smp_OpenApp

data.name: Smp_OpenSite

data.name: Smp_OpenChat

data.name: Smp_ShowDesktop

data.name: Smp_RemWater

data.name: Smp_RemWrapUp
data.value: Time to wrap up — any loose ends on today's to-do? (sample)

data.name: Smp_RemBills
data.value: Check this month's bills and subscriptions (sample · on the 1st)

data.name: Confirm_RelaunchAdmin
data.value: This action needs administrator rights. Reopen Clockwork as administrator?

data.name: Confirm_DeleteGroupRefs
data.value: Action "{0}" is referenced by {1} reminder(s) and {2} step(s). Deleting it will also clear those references (reminders become popup-only; steps referencing it are removed). Delete anyway?

data.name: Ed_ActivateIfRunning
data.value: Activate window if already running (don't relaunch)

data.name: Ed_AltTargetsHint
data.value: One full path per line; when Target doesn't exist, the first existing one is used (for machines with different install paths)

data.name: Ed_GroupHotkeyHint
data.value: Click, then press a key combo to run this group anytime; press it again while it runs to stop it. Esc cancels, Del clears it.

data.name: Hotkey_GroupRegisterFail
data.value: Failed to register hotkey {1} for action “{0}”: it may already be in use

data.name: Val_HotkeyDup
data.value: Hotkey {0} is already used by “{1}”; choose a different combo

data.name: Hotkey_Reserved
data.value: {0} is a system-reserved combo (registering it would hijack a system key) and can't be used as a hotkey

data.name: Val_GroupCycle
data.value: Circular group reference ({0}) — break the reference chain before saving

data.name: Config_ImportConfirm
data.value: Importing will overwrite ALL current config (startup list / reminders / actions / settings). Continue?

data.name: Relaunch_Fail
data.value: Couldn't restart automatically. Please reopen Clockwork manually. ({0})

data.name: Sys_playSound
data.value: Play a sound (system sound or a .wav file)

data.name: Err_NoSelection
data.value: No text is selected. Select what you want to search for, then run this step.

data.name: Warn_NoForegroundWindow
data.value: There's no window to act on right now (Clockwork itself or the desktop is in front)

data.name: Ed_ProcessHint
data.value: Type * for the current window — the one you were using before you drew the gesture or opened the panel. Left empty, this step does nothing.

data.name: Ed_SearchUrlHint
data.value: {0} stands for the words being searched; they are escaped for you.

data.name: Ed_SoundHint
data.value: Leave this empty for the system notification sound. Or give the full path to a .wav file.

data.name: Err_PowerStateUnavailable
data.value: This machine doesn't support or has disabled that power state (run powercfg /a to check)

data.name: Ed_BrightnessHint
data.value: Only works on system-controlled displays (laptop panels); external monitors are not supported.

data.name: Ed_AfterTimeHint
data.value: Format H:mm, e.g. 18:30; entering just the hour (e.g. 18) also works; default 18:00.

data.name: Ed_IfPathHint
data.value: If filled in, the step runs only when that file / folder exists; leave empty for no limit.

data.name: Ed_IdleHint
data.value: Fires once after this many minutes with no keyboard or mouse activity; the count restarts when you come back.

data.name: Ed_BatteryHint
data.value: Fires once when running on battery and the charge drops below this; it re-arms after charging back up or plugging in.

data.name: Ed_EventHint
data.value: Runs the moment the event happens. The weekday boxes below still limit which days it counts; grace and catch-up don't apply to events and are hidden.

data.name: Picker_StartMenu
data.value: Pick apps from the Start menu

data.name: Picker_MultiHint
data.value: Select several with Ctrl / Shift; each one is added to the list as a step, unticked by default.

data.name: Picker_StartMenuEmpty
data.value: No program shortcuts were found in the Start menu.

data.name: Settings_BackupTip
data.value: Exports a single .json file. Importing replaces all current settings.

data.name: Settings_StartupDelayTip
data.value: 0-600 s, and only when Start at login is on: waits this long after login before running the list, so it misses the login storm. Manual re-runs are unaffected.

data.name: Settings_WaitReady
data.value: Wait until the system is ready (desktop / network)

data.name: Settings_WaitReadyTip
data.value: Goes as soon as both are ready, waiting at most 90 s, then the fixed delay above is added on top. Turn this on when the list runs too early for your apps.

data.name: Ed_LoginSilentHint
data.value: Opening apps at login with ordering and delays is easier on the Startup List; gates like “only within N minutes of boot” or “mornings only” are exactly what this place is for.

data.name: Ed_NoGroupsHint
data.value: No actions yet — make one on the Actions tab, then come back and pick it here.

data.name: Adv_NagUntil
data.value: nags every {0} min until confirmed, at most until {1}

data.name: Adv_Loop
data.value: runs every {0} min until end of day (confirming doesn't stop it)

data.name: Adv_LoopUntil
data.value: runs every {0} min until {1} (confirming doesn't stop it)

data.name: Ed_BusyHint
data.value: Fires once after this many minutes of continuous use; a full minute away restarts the count.

data.name: Settings_PanelHotkeyTip
data.value: Pops a tile panel at the mouse, one action per tile. Esc cancels, Del clears it; middle-button hold and the tray menu still open it.

data.name: Panel_Empty
data.value: The panel is empty. The actions you put on it show up here.

data.name: Warn_StartupSkippedFile
data.value: Startup list skipped. Delete {0} to let it run automatically again.

data.name: Warn_StartupSkippedShift
data.value: Startup list skipped because Shift was held at launch. Just this once — the next boot runs as usual.

data.name: Warn_GroupDisabled
data.value: Action "{0}" is switched off — nothing ran.

data.name: Settings_MiddleLongPress
data.value: Hold the middle mouse button to open the panel

data.name: Settings_MiddleLongPressTip
data.value: A normal middle click still works — a short press is passed through untouched. Off by default, because it needs a global mouse hook.

data.name: Warn_MouseHookFail
data.value: Couldn't install the mouse hook, so middle-button hold is off. Security software or group policy may have blocked it; the panel still opens from the hotkey or the tray menu.

data.name: Settings_UsePanelTip
data.value: Turn it off and the hotkey goes back to other apps, the middle-button hook is not installed, and the tray entry disappears. Your panel pages stay — you can still tidy them under Manage panel.

data.name: Settings_UseGesturesTip
data.value: Turn it off and the right button is not watched at all, so it behaves normally again. The gestures themselves are drawn in the gesture manager, from the Actions tab sidebar.

data.name: Settings_PanelLayoutTip
data.value: Columns × top rows + bottom rows sets how much fits on a page and how wide the panel gets. The rest spills onto the next page; set bottom rows to 0 for a single band.

data.name: Settings_PanelIconOnlyTip
data.value: Names stay in the tooltip, and far more actions fit on one screen.

data.name: Ed_IconHint
data.value: Left empty it fills itself in: *Launch App* takes the target’s own icon, everything else gets a line icon for its type.

data.name: Panel_NoPages
data.value: No pages yet. The + at the end of the page tab rail makes one; then put actions on it.

data.name: Panel_CategoryHint
data.value: Which category this page belongs to. The top row has one tab per category; picking one lists just its pages.

data.name: Panel_ManagerHint
data.value: Click a category above, a page on the left. Double-click to rename, drag tabs to reorder, drop one on a category to move that page into it; drop a tile on a tab to move it into that page. Right-click a tab to rename or delete it.

data.name: Panel_BarsHint
data.value: The top row picks a category; the left one lists that category’s pages. With one category the top row is not drawn, and with one page in the current category neither is the left — these ticks force them out of sight when there are more. The manager always keeps its category row: the + on it is how you make a category.

data.name: Panel_SceneHint
data.value: Leave it empty and the page is always there. Name a process and it only appears when that app was in front as you opened the panel.

data.name: Icon_PickHint
data.value: Beyond these, you can use an image of your own, or any exe and borrow its icon.

data.name: Panel_SearchNone
data.value: No action matches that. Try another word, or press Esc to go back to the panel.

data.name: Panel_SearchMore
data.value: Showing the first {0} of {1} matches. Type a bit more to narrow it down.

data.name: Settings_ThemeTip
data.value: Clockwork restarts right away to apply the new theme. "Match Windows" follows the app mode in Windows settings.

data.name: Gesture_AppHint
data.value: The gesture fires only when this app is in the foreground. Leave it blank to work in every app.
